whatIs.question: What is MuiStory?
whatIs.answer: MuiStory is an interactive fiction creation platform. Write interactive stories with a Markdown editor, add branching choices, variables, and multimedia elements, then publish for readers to experience. The AI writing assistant helps improve your prose and check plot consistency.

howCreate.question: How do I create my own story?
howCreate.answer: After registering, go to the dashboard and click 'Create Game'. Use the editor to write scene content, add choices to connect different scenes, and set variables and conditions for branching narratives. The AI assistant can help polish your text and optimize the plot.

pricing.question: Is it free to use?
pricing.answer: Core creation and publishing features are free forever. The multimodal AI creation suite (AI Story Co-pilot, illustrations, video, music, and voice acting) is currently 100% FREE for a limited time upon registration! We will also continue providing a generous free tier and support for personal API keys.

export.question: Can I export to other platforms?
export.answer: Currently you can publish to the Web. We're developing Ren'Py script export and desktop app packaging, so you'll be able to publish to Steam, itch.io, and more.

aiRole.question: What role does AI play in creation?
aiRole.answer: AI is your writing assistant, not your replacement. It can help polish prose, improve dialogue quality, check plot consistency, and generate images and sound effects. The story's creativity and direction are always in your hands.

about.pageDescription: Learn about MuiStory's core features, technical architecture, and vision
about.heroSubtitle: An AI-powered interactive story creation platform, empowering everyone to become storytellers
about.missionContent: We believe everyone has a story to tell. MuiStory uses AI technology to lower the barrier to creating interactive fiction and text adventure games, so creativity is no longer limited by technical skills. Our goal is to let authors control AI, rather than be controlled by it, ensuring story quality and gameplay.
about.featuresSubtitle: Powerful AI tools make storytelling simple and fun

aiAssist.title: AI-Assisted Creation
aiAssist.description: Zero coding required. Describe your ideas in natural language, and AI generates complete scripts. Import story outlines and generate branching narratives with one click.

aiChatbot.title: 24/7 AI Chatbot Assistant
aiChatbot.description: Always-available smart assistant to answer questions, optimize plots, and refine details. As simple as talking to a professional screenwriter.

variables.title: Variable System, Infinite Possibilities
variables.description: Use variables to change story paths based on player choices. Supports affection, items, attributes, and more.

minigames.title: Scene Mini Games
minigames.description: AI automatically generates interactive mini-games like puzzles and combat. Stories become not just readable, but playable.

richInteractive.title: Rich Multimedia
richInteractive.description: Support AI-generated images, voice, and other multimedia content for immersive reading experiences.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-Platform Publishing
crossPlatform.description: One-click publish to Web with responsive design for all devices. Easy sharing with friends.

about.aiSectionContent1: Our AI assistant can not only generate scripts but also understand your creative intent. Through natural language conversation, you can adjust story direction, optimize dialogue, and add interactive elements anytime.
about.aiSectionContent2: Supports multiple AI models including GPT-4 and Gemini to ensure creative quality. Built-in prompt templates help AI better understand interactive storytelling.
about.editorSectionContent1: Intuitive node-based editor lets you build stories like building blocks. Drag and connect to create branching narratives, what you see is what you get.
about.editorSectionContent2: Supports multi-scene management, character systems, variable editing, and other advanced features. Even complex multi-branch stories are easy to handle.

parser.title: DSL Parser
parser.description: Custom story scripting language supporting variables, conditions, loops, and more. TypeScript implementation, type-safe.

assetGenerator.title: Asset Generator
assetGenerator.description: Integrated with multiple AI image generation services, supporting batch generation and cache optimization. Auto compression and CDN distribution.

cloudflare.title: Edge Deployment
cloudflare.description: Built on Cloudflare Workers and D1 database, global edge deployment with millisecond response times.

about.platformSectionContent1: Responsive design ensures perfect experience on phones, tablets, and computers. PWA support lets you use it like a native app.
about.platformSectionContent2: Cloud-stored game progress, seamless cross-device continuation. Share links to let friends experience your creations.
about.ctaContent: Whether you want to experience amazing interactive stories or create your own adventures, MuiStory is here for you.

interactiveFiction.pageTitle: Interactive Fiction - Online Interactive Story Platform
interactiveFiction.pageDescription: Interactive fiction is a story form where your choices decide the plot. MuiStory is a free online interactive fiction website: play interactive stories, or create and self-publish your own with Markdown and AI.
interactiveFiction.heroTitle: Interactive Fiction: Every Choice You Make Shapes the Story
interactiveFiction.heroSubtitle: Interactive fiction is a narrative form that lets readers participate through choices. You decide for the protagonist, and the story branches according to your decisions. MuiStory (muistory.com) offers free online interactive stories to play and create — this is where you start.
interactiveFiction.whatIsContent: Interactive fiction turns "reading" into "choosing": at key moments, you make decisions for the protagonist, and the story branches into different paths with different endings. The same work reads completely differently for each reader. Web interactive fiction needs no download — just open your browser and play.
interactiveFiction.howToPlayTitle: How do web interactive novels work?
interactiveFiction.howToPlayContent: Reading interactive fiction on the web is simple: read like a novel, and when choices appear, click one — your decision instantly changes the story. Some works include variable systems: items, affinity and key choices you accumulate will genuinely affect what happens later.

interactiveFiction.featuredSubtitle: From suspense and exorcism to classic adaptations, these works deserve your choices.

howToPlay.pageTitle: How to Play Interactive Fiction - Web Interactive Novel Guide
howToPlay.pageDescription: How do web interactive novels work? From branching choices and variable systems to multiple endings, this guide helps you start playing interactive fiction games and understand how every choice changes the story.
howToPlay.heroTitle: How do web interactive novels work?
howToPlay.heroSubtitle: Choices, branches, endings — the joy of interactive fiction is that every decision you make counts.
howToPlay.stepTitle: Three steps into an interactive story
howToPlay.step1Content: Interactive fiction has a complete plot and characters just like the novels you know. Enjoy the story unfolding — there is no rush to decide.
howToPlay.step2Content: The story pauses to hand the decision to you: choices can change dialogue, unlock new scenes, grant items, or lead the story in a completely different direction.
howToPlay.step3Content: A single work can have multiple endings. After finishing, go back and choose another branch to see what kind of story different choices create.
howToPlay.mechanicBranchContent: Every choice branches the story, and multiple endings invite you to explore the same work again and again.
howToPlay.mechanicVariableContent: Some works track your state: affinity, items, key events. These states genuinely affect which options and endings you can reach later.
howToPlay.mechanicRestartContent: Missed something? Most works let you restart anytime — exploring every possibility is a valid way to play.
howToPlay.ctaTitle: Pick a story and try it
howToPlay.ctaSubtitle: No registration needed — open and play.

create.pageTitle: How to Create Interactive Fiction - No-Code Guide to Self-Publishing
create.pageDescription: Want to create your own interactive fiction? MuiStory lets you write stories in Markdown, polish with AI, add branching and variables, and publish with one click — self-publishing to the web and beyond, no programming needed.
create.heroTitle: Creating interactive fiction is easier than you think
create.heroSubtitle: Write your story in the Markdown you already know. Full multimodal AI tools are currently FREE for a limited time to polish prose, generate art, music and sound effects. Publish everywhere with one click.
create.step1Content: No programming required. Write your plot in familiar Markdown syntax; the editor autosaves and offers smart hints, designed specifically for interactive fiction.
create.step2Content: The AI assistant polishes prose, improves dialogue and checks plot consistency. It can also generate scene art, background music and character voices — currently 100% free.
create.step3Content: Add branching choices, variable systems, conditional text, even embed minigames — make the reader a participant in the story.
create.step4Content: Publishing to the web goes live instantly, with a dedicated link and sharing capability. Future support includes exporting Ren'Py scripts or desktop apps for stores like Steam.
create.featureTitle: Why self-published interactive fiction is worth it
create.feature1Content: Create without any programming background. Register and begin — core creation features are free.
create.feature2Content: Prose, art, audio, dialogue quality — the AI assistant is on call, while you stay in control of the creative direction.
create.feature3Content: Your story, your design choices, your world — the platform provides tools; the work and its readers are always yours.
create.ctaSubtitle: Register and start creating for free.
